subject: Fail fast on invalid certificates at TLS config load (#2999)
reason: The change only adds certificate-validity checks in src/tls.c's createSSLContext, reached when a TLS-enabled build loads a TLS config (at startup or on CONFIG SET of a tls-* option). Exercising the new branch needs a BUILD_TLS=yes binary, an active TLS listener, and deliberately expired/not-yet-valid certificate files on disk. The fuzzer has no TLS provisioning: no certificate component, tls-port is a managed/refused server_config option, no experiment or action enables a TLS listener, and no primitive can generate time-invalid certificates (valkey.action.commands files: writes only static byt
